## 01 - Daily Gmail Digest to Telegram
Every day at 08:00 (Asia/Hebron) this reads unread Gmail emails from the last 24h (no Promotions/Social, max 20), summarizes them in Arabic with Gemini, and sends one digest to Telegram. If there are no emails, it sends a short notice instead. Long digests are split under Telegram's 4096-char limit.

**Connect:** Gmail OAuth2, Google Gemini API, Telegram Bot API.
**Set:** your chat ID in the "Set Chat ID" node.
Use "Test Manually" to run it on demand.

messageValues.message: You are a personal email assistant. Write in clear Arabic. Group the emails into: 🔴 عاجل (needs action today), 🟡 مهم (read soon), ⚪ عادي (informational). For each email give one line: sender — short summary — and the action required if any. Keep the whole message under 3500 characters. Do not invent information. Output plain text only (no Markdown, no HTML tags).

nodeGroups.name: Collect new emails
nodeGroups.description: Pulls the last 24h of unread inbox mail (no promos/social) and checks whether anything new arrived

nodeGroups.name: Deliver Arabic digest
nodeGroups.description: Trims each email, has AI sort them into urgent / important / normal in Arabic, then posts to your chat in 4096-char parts
